'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[2023 Khyber blast]]
***Two [[Pakistan Army|soldiers]] are killed after their vehicle hits a [[Improvised explosive device|roadside bomb]] in [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. In a separate incident, a [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police|police officer]] is killed and two more injured during a [[grenade]] attack in [[Swabi]]. The [[Pakistani Taliban]] claims responsibility for both attacks. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-taliban-bomb-attack-soldiers-7c9a131fc2a96be494c9ca0db9a8e15f (Associated Press)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[United States documents leak of the Russian invasion of Ukraine|2023 Pentagon document leaks]]
**Two sets of classified documents of the [[United States]] relating to the [[Russo-Ukrainian War]] are leaked online. The leaks also include intelligence that the United States holds on other nations, including [[North Korea]], [[China]], [[Iran]], and the [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/04/07/politics/pentagon-leaked-ukraine-documents/index.html (CNN)] 
**The documents are compiled from multiple sources, including the [[Central Intelligence Agency]], [[National Security Agency]], and the [[Bureau of Intelligence and Research]] of the [[United States Department of State|State Department]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/04/07/politics/pentagon-leaked-ukraine-documents/index.html (CNN)] 
*[[Law Enforcement Command of the Islamic Republic of Iran|Police]] in [[Iran]] announce the installment of cameras in public places to identify and penalize women who do not observe [[dressing code]]s for [[hijab]]s, while also urging citizens to confront women who are not sufficiently covered. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-installs-cameras-public-places-identify-penalise-unveiled-women-police-2023-04-08/ (Reuters)]
